items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I think it’s great when I think of people like Sean Jones you know, now going to Peabody.

ctx.x: Okay. Let’s wrap up with what do you think of the state of jazz education? Do you have an opinion?

I think it’s good because there’s always a new crop of young people that are willing to commit to the journey. And they’re looking to be educated not just in institutions but in the experience of having mentors and real life, you know, experience, gigs. That’s where you really learn. You learn a lot in school as well and I think it’s great when I think of people like Sean Jones you know, now going to Peabody. And I hear the young people playing that are very good you know. So I think we’re in a great space. I…
Good. Well I’m looking forward to hearing you tonight.
